Status.note: The regulator's list dated 26 June 2026 moves both units to finally closed with closure year 2025. A Mark-E press release of 20 January 2026 says the plant at the site is no longer in operation. It does not say final closure. So the change rests on one source and is medium. Register rows from the Bundesnetzagentur power plant list with data date 26 June 2026: 'Heizkraftwerk Hagen Kabel H4', 129.5 MW gross, and 'Heizkraftwerk Hagen-Kabel H5', 124.5 MW gross,, commissioned 1981, status 'endgültig stillgelegt nach § 13b EnWG', meaning finally closed,, closure year 2025, listed under closed plants. The two add up to 254 MW, the same as the database.

Retired year.note: The closure year in the regulator's list is 2025 for both units. I found no second document with the year.

Latest Activity.note: The data date of the regulator's list. The earlier Mark-E press release of 20 January 2026 also calls the plant no longer in operation.
